keyFindings.description: Structure (Fast-follow, not blocking): `pictureNodeView(view)` is a factory closing over the `EditorView` it is handed, while prosemirror-view passes that same view as the constructor's second argument (`NodeViewConstructor = (node, view, getPos, …)`, dist/index.d.ts:617; built at dist/index.js:1297-1305) - the `_view` placeholder it discards is the captured object. A plain `export const pictureNodeView: NodeViewConstructor = (node, view, getPos) => …` and `image: pictureNodeView` removes the layer with identical behaviour.

The round's one behaviour token (`stopEvent` false for `dragstart`) has no pin: the two `stopEvent` assertions pass a `click`; the e2e drag row's `dragstart` targets the wrapper (`link.draggable = false`), so it ran the same before and after. The path is not reachable by gesture (tester, round 4), so this is a contract pin, not a missing regression lock - one assertion beside the link case when the file is next touched.
